AUTHORIZATION_AND_TARGET_IDENTITY.decision: AdminCrystalAdjustmentService fails closed unless actor_user_id is authorized by the admin policy port. The target is an account identified only by target_user_id; current character_name is presentation metadata resolved at read time and never a financial identity.

CREDIT_DEBIT_AND_CLAMP_POLICY.decision: Requested amount must be a positive integer. Credit applies the full requested amount. Debit is clamped to min(requested_amount,current_balance), never produces a negative balance, and records requested_amount and applied_amount separately. A zero applied debit is a valid audited no-op receipt.

PREVIEW_CONFIRMATION_AND_IDEMPOTENCY.decision: Preview returns an immutable quote containing actor_user_id, target_user_id, adjustment_kind, requested_amount, expected_balance_before and applied_amount. Confirmation requires a stable operation_key. Identical replay returns the original receipt; changed payload conflicts. A changed balance makes the quote stale and rejects before mutation.

WALLET_LEDGER_ATOMICITY_AND_COMPENSATION.decision: Wallet mutation, canonical Crystal Ledger entry and immutable admin adjustment receipt execute in one caller-owned Unit of Work with one commit. Any pre-commit failure rolls all effects back. Compensation is reserved for an explicitly committed downstream recovery operation and must reference the original transaction.

NOTIFICATION_ORDERING_AND_FAILURE_POLICY.decision: Financial commit occurs before recipient notification. Notification delivery is a post-commit side effect with its own delivery status and retry key. Delivery failure never rolls back or repeats the crystal adjustment; retry may only resend the notice for the existing receipt.

HISTORY_DETAIL_AND_CONSUMER_ALLOWLIST.decision: History is newest-first, ten records per page, persistent without expiry, and detail exposes operation key, actor, target, kind, requested/applied amounts, balances and timestamp. Current character_name is resolved when rendering. Only admin presentation and explicit audit/testing adapters may consume the service; direct SQL, handler-owned mutation and duplicate admin adjustment owners are forbidden.

   if not result.get('success'):bot.answer_callback_query(call.id,result.get('message','Операцію не знайдено.'),show_alert=True);return

   nonce=data.split(':',2)[2]

   if result.get('success'):

    _clear(uid);bot.edit_message_text(f"✅ Операцію завершено.\nЗапитано: {result['requested_amount']} 💎\nФактично: {result['actual_amount']} 💎\nБаланс: {result['balance_before']} → {result['balance_after']} 💎{delivery_note}",call.message.chat.id,call.message.message_id);bot.answer_callback_query(call.id,'Готово')
